_readme: GT (2026-10-02, owner ruling D6): the STARTER ALLOWLIST for the per-bar runtime pane.
While PINE_RUNTIME_STAGE is admins or all, the runtime lane draws ONLY a script whose
Pine source sha256 (UTF-8, as written) starts with one of the sha256 values below or one
in the PINE_RUNTIME_ALLOWLIST variable on web (the server reads the union, per request).
Every other script declines by name (runtime:not-yet-graded) with the host lane's sentence.
ADD A SCRIPT ONLY WHEN A TRADINGVIEW CAPTURE GRADES IT MATCH: one object per script, naming
the capture. Read by api/services/runtime_definitions.py::allow_list. An empty list serves
nothing. Edit this file as text; never round-trip it through a serialiser.
